acceptanceCriteria: Detach focused tests pass on Linux (CI or local container) with evidence retained.
Attach during child startup never reports LOST; test with an injected startup delay pins it.
body: Found by lane V1-1547 (claim --detach, PR beamfall/corvint#1015, head 01eae41a5, base 8fa297eae, corvint build 615) on 2026-10-17. Detach tests ran on darwin only. A brief window was observed where an attach sees the detached attempt as LOST before the child publishes. Expected: Linux evidence and no transient LOST on attach.
title: Run claim --detach tests on Linux and close the brief LOST attach race
